panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing in Prometheus: critical as FAILING, everything else as WARNING. Silences in Alertmanager are not taken into account.

targets.expr:
max by (alertname, namespace, pod, job_name, cronjob, persistentvolumeclaim, obj_name) (
  ((ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor", severity="critical"}) * 0 + 3)
  or ((ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}) * 0 + 1)
)
# keep the table from being empty
or (label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "No alerts firing", "", "") unless on () count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}) > 0)

panels.title: Backups & maintenance
panels.description: VolSync backups and CronJobs (kopia maintenance, zfs scrub). FAILING: last run failed, out of sync, repository unreachable or overdue by an hour. UNKNOWN: never succeeded. Click a name to filter the error logs to its job.

targets.expr:
label_join(label_replace(max by (ns, name) (((max by (ns, name) (label_replace(volsync_replicationsource_info{result!~"Successful|"}, "ns", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(volsync_volume_out_of_sync{role="source"}, "ns", "$1", "obj_namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "obj_name", "(.*)")) == 1) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(volsync_kopia_repository_connectivity{role="source"}, "ns", "$1", "obj_namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "obj_name", "(.*)")) == 0) * 0 + 3)
  or ((time() - max by (ns, name) (label_replace(volsync_replicationsource_next_sync_timestamp_seconds, "ns", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")) > 3600) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (ns, name) (label_replace(volsync_replicationsource_info, "ns", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")) unless max by (ns, name) (label_replace(volsync_replicationsource_last_sync_timestamp_seconds, "ns", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((max by (ns, name) (label_replace(volsync_replicationsource_info, "ns", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 0)), "type", "VolSync", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (ns, name) ((((max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_status_last_schedule_time, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)")) > max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)"))) and max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_status_active, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)")) == 0) * 0 + 3)
  or (((max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_status_last_schedule_time, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)")) unless max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)"))) and max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_status_active, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)")) == 0) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_info, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)")) unless max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_info, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 0)), "type", "CronJob", "", ""), "target", "/", "ns", "name")

label_join(label_replace(max by (ns, name) (time() - max by (ns, name) (label_replace(volsync_replicationsource_last_sync_timestamp_seconds, "ns", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"))), "type", "VolSync", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (ns, name) (time() - max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)"))), "type", "CronJob", "", ""), "target", "/", "ns", "name")

label_join(label_replace(max by (ns, name) (max by (ns, name) (label_replace(volsync_replicationsource_next_sync_timestamp_seconds, "ns", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")) - time()), "type", "VolSync", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (ns, name) (max by (ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_cronjob_next_schedule_time, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "cronjob", "(.*)")) - time()), "type", "CronJob", "", ""), "target", "/", "ns", "name")

panels.title: Platform
panels.description: Node conditions, zpool health/capacity/read-only, SMART, certificates, the Flux instance and every Prometheus scrape target.

targets.expr:
label_replace(max by (name) (((max by (name) (label_replace(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}, "name", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) == 0) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(kube_node_status_condition{condition=~".+Pressure", status="true"}, "name", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) == 1) * 0 + 1)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}, "name", "$1", "node", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 0)), "type", "Node", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (name) (((label_replace(max(rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total[15m])), "name", "CPU pressure", "", "") > 0.5) * 0 + 3)
  or ((label_replace(max(rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total[15m])), "name", "CPU pressure", "", "") > 0.2) * 0 + 1)
  or ((label_replace(vector(0), "name", "CPU pressure", "", "") unless on () max(rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total[15m]))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((label_replace(max(rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total[15m])), "name", "CPU pressure", "", "")) * 0 + 0)
  or ((label_replace(max(rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total[15m])), "name", "Memory pressure", "", "") > 0.5) * 0 + 3)
  or ((label_replace(max(rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total[15m])), "name", "Memory pressure", "", "") > 0.2) * 0 + 1)
  or ((label_replace(vector(0), "name", "Memory pressure", "", "") unless on () max(rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total[15m]))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((label_replace(max(rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total[15m])), "name", "Memory pressure", "", "")) * 0 + 0)
  or ((label_replace(max(rate(node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total[15m])), "name", "IO pressure", "", "") > 0.5) * 0 + 3)
  or ((label_replace(max(rate(node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total[15m])), "name", "IO pressure", "", "") > 0.2) * 0 + 1)
  or ((label_replace(vector(0), "name", "IO pressure", "", "") unless on () max(rate(node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total[15m]))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((label_replace(max(rate(node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total[15m])), "name", "IO pressure", "", "")) * 0 + 0)
  or ((label_replace(max(increase(node_vmstat_oom_kill[24h])), "name", "Kernel OOM kills (24h)", "", "") > 0.5) * 0 + 1)
  or ((label_replace(vector(0), "name", "Kernel OOM kills (24h)", "", "") unless on () max(increase(node_vmstat_oom_kill[24h]))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((label_replace(max(increase(node_vmstat_oom_kill[24h])), "name", "Kernel OOM kills (24h)", "", "")) * 0 + 0)
  or ((label_replace(max(node_timex_sync_status), "name", "Clock sync", "", "") == 0) * 0 + 3)
  or ((label_replace(vector(0), "name", "Clock sync", "", "") unless on () max(node_timex_sync_status)) * 0 + 2)
  or ((label_replace(max(node_timex_sync_status), "name", "Clock sync", "", "")) * 0 + 0)
  or ((label_replace(max(abs(node_timex_offset_seconds)), "name", "Clock offset", "", "") > 0.05) * 0 + 1)
  or ((label_replace(vector(0), "name", "Clock offset", "", "") unless on () max(abs(node_timex_offset_seconds))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((label_replace(max(abs(node_timex_offset_seconds)), "name", "Clock offset", "", "")) * 0 + 0)), "type", "Node", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (name) (((label_replace(max(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_bucket[15m])))), "name", "WAL fsync p99", "", "") > 0.1) * 0 + 3)
  or ((label_replace(max(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_bucket[15m])))), "name", "WAL fsync p99", "", "") > 0.025) * 0 + 1)
  or ((label_replace(vector(0), "name", "WAL fsync p99", "", "") unless on () max(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_bucket[15m]))))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((label_replace(max(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_bucket[15m])))), "name", "WAL fsync p99", "", "")) * 0 + 0)), "type", "etcd", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (name) (((label_replace(max(sum(increase(alertmanager_notifications_failed_total[1h]))), "name", "Notifications failed (1h)", "", "") > 2) * 0 + 3)
  or ((label_replace(max(sum(increase(alertmanager_notifications_failed_total[1h]))), "name", "Notifications failed (1h)", "", "") > 0.5) * 0 + 1)
  or ((label_replace(vector(0), "name", "Notifications failed (1h)", "", "") unless on () max(sum(increase(alertmanager_notifications_failed_total[1h])))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((label_replace(max(sum(increase(alertmanager_notifications_failed_total[1h]))), "name", "Notifications failed (1h)", "", "")) * 0 + 0)
  or ((label_replace(max(sum(increase(prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total[1h]))), "name", "Rule evaluation failures (1h)", "", "") > 0.5) * 0 + 1)
  or ((label_replace(vector(0), "name", "Rule evaluation failures (1h)", "", "") unless on () max(sum(increase(prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total[1h])))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((label_replace(max(sum(increase(prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total[1h]))), "name", "Rule evaluation failures (1h)", "", "")) * 0 + 0)), "type", "Alerting", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (name) (((max by (name) (label_replace(zfs_pool_health, "name", "$1", "pool", "(.*)")) != 0) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(zfs_pool_readonly, "name", "$1", "pool", "(.*)")) == 1) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(zfs_pool_allocated_bytes, "name", "$1", "pool", "(.*)")) / max by (name) (label_replace(zfs_pool_size_bytes, "name", "$1", "pool", "(.*)")) > 0.9) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(zfs_pool_allocated_bytes, "name", "$1", "pool", "(.*)")) / max by (name) (label_replace(zfs_pool_size_bytes, "name", "$1", "pool", "(.*)")) > 0.8) * 0 + 1)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(node_zfs_zpool_state, "name", "$1", "zpool", "(.*)")) unless max by (name) (label_replace(zfs_pool_size_bytes, "name", "$1", "pool", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(node_zfs_zpool_state, "name", "$1", "zpool", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 0)), "type", "ZFS pool", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (name) (((max by (name) (label_replace(smartctl_device_smart_status, "name", "$1", "device", "(.*)")) != 1) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name="Wear_Leveling_Count", attribute_value_type="value"}, "name", "$1", "device", "(.*)")) < 20) * 0 + 1)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(smartctl_device_temperature{temperature_type="current"}, "name", "$1", "device", "(.*)")) > 65) * 0 + 1)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(node_disk_info{device=~"sd.+|nvme.+n[0-9]+", path!~".*-usb-.*"}, "name", "$1", "device", "(.*)")) unless max by (name) (label_replace(smartctl_device_smart_status, "name", "$1", "device", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 2)
  or ((max by (name) (label_replace(node_disk_info{device=~"sd.+|nvme.+n[0-9]+", path!~".*-usb-.*"}, "name", "$1", "device", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 0)), "type", "Disk", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (name) (((max by (name) (label_join(certmanager_certificate_ready_status{condition="False"}, "name", "/", "exported_namespace", "name")) == 1) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (name) (label_join(certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds, "name", "/", "exported_namespace", "name")) - time() < 7 * 86400) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (name) (label_join(certmanager_certificate_ready_status{condition="Unknown"}, "name", "/", "exported_namespace", "name")) == 1) * 0 + 2)
  or ((max by (name) (label_join(certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds, "name", "/", "exported_namespace", "name")) - time() < 14 * 86400) * 0 + 1)
  or ((max by (name) (label_join(certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds, "name", "/", "exported_namespace", "name"))) * 0 + 0)), "type", "Certificate", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (name) (((max by (name) (flux_instance_info{ready="False"})) * 0 + 3)
  or ((max by (name) (flux_instance_info{ready!="True"})) * 0 + 2)
  or ((max by (name) (flux_instance_info)) * 0 + 0)), "type", "Flux", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (name) (((min by (name) (label_replace(up, "name", "$1", "job", "(.*)")) == 0) * 0 + 3)
  or ((min by (name) (label_replace(up, "name", "$1", "job", "(.*)"))) * 0 + 0)), "type", "Scrape target", "", "")

panels.title: Workloads
panels.description: FAILING: no replica ready. WARNING: not all replicas ready, or containers restarted in the last 24h. Click a workload to filter the error logs to it.

targets.expr:
label_join(max by (type, ns, name) ((((max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "type", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "type", "DaemonSet", "", ""))) > 0 and (max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "type", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_ready, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "type", "DaemonSet", "", ""))) == 0) * 0 + 3)
  or (((max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "type", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_ready, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "type", "DaemonSet", "", ""))) < (max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "type", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "type", "DaemonSet", "", "")))) * 0 + 1)
  or (((max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "type", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "type", "DaemonSet", "", ""))) and sum by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[24h])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (type, name) max by (namespace, pod, type, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}, "name", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"), "type", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.*)") or max by (namespace, pod, replicaset) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (type, name) max by (namespace, replicaset, type, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"}, "name", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", ""))), "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)")) > 0) * 0 + 1)
  or (((max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "type", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "type", "DaemonSet", "", "")))) * 0 + 0)), "target", "/", "ns", "name")

label_join((max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "type", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_ready, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "type", "DaemonSet", "", ""))), "target", "/", "ns", "name")

label_join((max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "type", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "type", "DaemonSet", "", ""))), "target", "/", "ns", "name")

label_join(sum by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[24h])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (type, name) max by (namespace, pod, type, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}, "name", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"), "type", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.*)") or max by (namespace, pod, replicaset) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (type, name) max by (namespace, replicaset, type, name) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"}, "name", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", ""))), "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)")) or (max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "type", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "type", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (type, ns, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled, "ns", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "name", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "type", "DaemonSet", "", ""))) * 0, "target", "/", "ns", "name")

panels.title: Apps (via Envoy)
panels.description: Every HTTPRoute behind Envoy. FAILING: no healthy endpoint, or over 20% 5xx in the last hour. WARNING: over 2% 5xx or failed upstream connections in the last hour. Click an app for its error logs.

targets.expr:
